articles.title: Indians ditch gold for gemstones as sales jump 40%; stones cost Rs 5 lakh
articles.summary: The growing preference for premium coloured gemstones as against gold is also translating into higher prices. Paraiba tourmalines, among the rarest gemstones, sell for around Rs 5 lakh per carat in India.

articles.title: Sold commercial units & bought 2 flats, taxman denies Rs 2.5 crore relief on one - what ITAT said
articles.summary: A man sold six commercial units in Mumbai and the sales generated long-term capital gains of around Rs 5 crore. He claimed a deduction of the same amount under Section 54F after investing in residential property.

articles.title: Gold imports account for half of India's $10 billion trade deficit surge: here's why
articles.summary: India's merchandise trade deficit widened to $40 billion in October, with higher gold imports accounting for half the monthly increase.

articles.title: Property seller takes Rs 5.22 lakh cash, faces tax penalty; why ITAT gave relief
articles.summary: The Income Tax Assessing Officer (AO) in Berhampur received information from the property registrar's office in Jharsuguda that the man had sold a property and collected Rs 5.22 lakh in cash as part of the payment. The registered sale deed also mentioned the cash component.

articles.title: CCPA fines Ola ₹10 lakh over pre-ride tipping prompts, calls practice misleading and unfair
articles.summary: The consumer watchdog has directed Ola to discontinue its pre-ride tipping feature, saying it misled passengers about their chances of securing rides. The regulator found that the payment prompts constituted an unfair trade practice and a dark pattern.

articles.title: 'My worry is that listing will change the Tata way': Noel Tata fears profit over philanthropy
articles.summary: Tata Trusts Chairman Noel N Tata on Saturday said that a public listing could fundamentally alter the group's philosophy, potentially placing shareholder profits ahead of philanthropy. He said the Trusts would work with regulators to protect the Tata way of doing business.

articles.title: 'Will change the Tata way': Noel warns Tata Sons listing could put profits ahead of philanthropy
India's $40 billion trade deficit raises concerns, but Axis Bank sees limited pressure on rupee. Here's why
articles.summary: India's merchandise trade deficit widened to $40 billion in October, raising concerns about pressure on the rupee. However, Axis Bank Research believes strong services earnings, returning foreign investments and easing oil prices could help contain external risks.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO draws six times demand, but valuation remains under scrutiny
Blackstone-backed AirTrunk plans ₹1.03 lakh crore investment in Andhra Pradesh for two data centre campuses
articles.summary: The company has submitted a detailed project report to the Andhra Pradesh government for the proposed facilities, which would have a combined capacity of up to 1.8 gigawatts (GW), according to an emailed statement from AirTrunk.

articles.title: What made India’s net power capacity addition fall to its lowest in a year?
articles.summary: India's net capacity addition fell 37%. Fossil fuel-based capacity additions slowed, with solar and coal additions falling, while gas and diesel capacity declined due to retirements.

articles.title: Binance restores withdrawals across 87 networks after record $6.3 billion crypto theft
articles.summary: After a security breach that resulted in the theft of $6.3 billion, Binance is diligently working to restore withdrawal services across its remaining networks and assets.

articles.title: YES Bank moves Supreme Court for review of ₹8,415 crore AT1 bond ruling
articles.summary: YES Bank has approached the Supreme Court seeking a review of its October 15 judgment overturning the write-down of ₹8,415 crore worth of Additional Tier-1 (AT1) bonds.

articles.title: US assures India of tariff advantage over rival economies under proposed trade pact
Wall Street's next bet: S&P 500 set to climb 14% despite slowing earnings growth - report
articles.summary: With a positive outlook for Wall Street's revival, Goldman Sachs anticipates the S&P 500 climbing to 8,700 points over the next year, which reflects a potential increase of more than 14% from its current level of 7,592.40.

articles.title: Spam calls: TRAI bars 1.24 lakh telecom resources, disconnects repeat offenders
articles.summary: TRAI has barred over 1.24 lakh telecom resources from outgoing services due to unsolicited commercial communication violations. During the July-September quarter, it received 15.29 lakh spam complaints, with 7.23 lakh being actionable.

articles.title: Why Indian Railways may scrap RAC; two passengers share one berth but pay full fare
articles.summary: RAC is a train ticket under which two passengers share a single berth even though each is charged the full fare and receives only half the sleeping space.

articles.title: Dollar nears 19-month high as inflation fuels bets on bigger Fed rate hike next month
articles.summary: The US dollar is experiencing its largest weekly gain in two months as expectations for interest rate hikes increase. Strong US inflation data and comments from Federal Reserve officials drive these predictions, which also raise treasury yields.

articles.title: Tata Group friction spills into operating firms as Voltas chairman pick bypasses Chandrasekaran’s nod
articles.summary: The development follows Noel Tata stepping down as chairman of several boards, including Voltas, earlier this week upon turning 70, the superannuation age for non-executive directors of the group.

articles.title: Jensen Huang's Nvidia exit costs him Rs 900 crore: How much wealth does he have left?
articles.summary: Jensen Huang is expected to lose around $108 million in unvested stock awards following his exit from Nvidia. His net worth, primarily composed of Nvidia shares, is around $144.5 billion. Huang's holdings include approximately 812 million shares, valued at about $135 billion.

articles.title: Office boy faces Rs 1.46 crore tax demand, alleges KYC misuse; why ITAT ruled in his favour
articles.summary: The Income Tax Department initiated reassessment proceedings against a man after receiving information about transactions associated with a pharma company, described in the information available to the tax authorities as the man’s proprietary concern.

articles.title: Nvidia spy scandal: What Jensen Huang told top officials about relationship with Alice
articles.summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has come under fire for misleading his top executives about an affair with Alice Huang. He characterized their ties as ordinary business dealings, not an intimate relationship.

articles.title: Tata Trusts vice chairmen hit back at Darius Khambata over Tata Sons listing, governance: Report
articles.summary: The clash follows Khambata’s November 2 letter to Trusts chairman Noel Tata, which faulted Tata Sons' engagement with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), opposed the holding company's proposed listing, and questioned trustee independence.

articles.title: Quote of the Day by Elon Musk: 'It's OK to have your eggs in one basket as long as you control what happens to that basket'
articles.summary: Elon Musk is a prominent billionaire entrepreneur, engineer, and tech mogul best known for founding and leading groundbreaking companies in space exploration, electric vehicles, and artificial intelligence.

articles.title: US flight disruption: Air India flags possible delays to US-bound services
articles.summary: Travelers on Air India flights faced significant delays due to a nationwide communication failure that affected the FAA, leading to a temporary ground halt of all flight departures across the U.S.

articles.title: ₹18.90 lakh Mahindra SUV at ₹51 lakh in UK? Three Indian EVs bring a price surprise
articles.summary: Mahindra plans to bring BE 6, XEV 9e and BE 07 electric SUVs to the UK. Explore estimated prices up to ₹65 lakh, claimed 708 km range, features and possible 2027 launch.

articles.title: 'Even Mannat was beyond our means': Shah Rukh Khan reveals his biggest dream in life
articles.summary: Shah Rukh Khan recalls buying his first home with Gauri, revealing even Mannat was beyond their means. Explore his emotional journey and the ₹50 crore Dubai penthouse launch.

articles.title: ‘They’re all coming up into good shape’: Sunil Bharti Mittal talks about succession, brings up sons, daughter, nephews
articles.summary: Sunil Bharti Mittal spoke of his sons, Sharvin and Kavin, his daughter Eiesha Bharti Pasricha, and his nephews, Zubin and Ramit from his brothers Rajan Bharti Mittal and Rakesh Bharti Mittal, and how the succession plan is shaping up.

articles.title: JLR to launch four luxury models, including Range Rover Electric and Jaguar Type 01; production begins in 2027
articles.summary: Jaguar Land Rover is preparing to expand its luxury vehicle portfolio with four upcoming models, including electric SUVs and the new Jaguar Type 01.

articles.title: US assures India of lower tariffs than peers under proposed trade deal: Report
articles.summary: The first phase of the agreement, which has been under discussion for nearly two years, will focus exclusively on goods, while services will be addressed in subsequent negotiations, as per news reports.

articles.title: 27.1% to 2.6%: India sees one of world’s fastest poverty declines, but there’s a catch
articles.summary: The World Bank currently defines the international extreme poverty line at $3.00 per person per day in 2021 purchasing power parity (PPP) terms. According to the World Poverty Clock, extreme poverty may be considered eliminated when the poverty headcount ratio falls below 3%.

articles.title: James Murdoch, Uday Shankar's Bodhi Tree to acquire majority stake in A2B for ₹1,696 crore
articles.summary: The partnership will focus on expanding A2B’s domestic and international operations while strengthening its packaged-food business

articles.summary: Jensen Huang co-founded Nvidia at a Denny's in 1993 and led it to a $5 trillion valuation. $1,000 put into its 1999 IPO would be worth about $6.6 million today.

articles.title: Who is Colette Kress? Nvidia results on 18 November, India time: The numbers to watch after Huang's exit
articles.summary: Nvidia reports on 17 November, its first results since Jensen Huang resigned. It has guided for about $108 billion in revenue. What to watch, and who is now running the company.

articles.summary: Jensen Huang's wealth fell about $9.9 billion, or roughly ₹93,000 crore, in the week of his exit, Fortune reported. He also gives up about $108 million in unvested shares.

articles.summary: Developers and institutions are advancing AI data-centre projects worth billions of dollars designed around restricted Nvidia H100, H200 and H800 processors.

articles.summary: The new Yesvantpur-Madgaon Vande Bharat Express has been introduced to improve rail connectivity between Bengaluru, coastal Karnataka and Goa.

articles.title: Paytm gets RBI prelim nod to operate wallets; shares surge to 52-week high
articles.summary: Paytm's payment segment has secured initial approval from the Reserve Bank of India for its prepaid payment instruments. This milestone has propelled One 97 Communications' stock to soar past the Rs 1,900 mark, reflecting strong market performance.

articles.title: India's exports jump 29.9% to $89.99 billion in October; overall trade deficit narrows
articles.summary: India's export growth shot up by almost 30 percent year-on-year, reaching close to $90 billion in October 2026. Merchandise exports accounted for a significant $49.47 billion, marking a record high for monthly goods.
